comments.comment: The native relative path is compared with a forward slash prefix without normalisation. The change removes separator normalisation. Windows relative paths use backslashes, so a pipeline source file no longer matches packages/pipeline/.
comments.failureScenario: On Windows, isPipelineSource("C:\repo", "C:\repo\packages\pipeline\src\review.ts") receives the declared absolute source paths. relative returns "packages\pipeline\src\review.ts", so the forward slash prefix does not match and the function returns false for a pipeline source file.
